evaluation.results_summary: The developer reports that this model is a supervised instruction-tuning model without RLHF, and that it shows favorable AlpacaEval 2.0 results compared to GPT4-0613, with a score of 31.2 versus 30.4.

identity.name: Infinity Instruct
identity.summary: An open-source instruction-tuned model developed by BAAI, trained with supervised fine-tuning rather than RLHF.

possible_risks.description: Hallucinations generate factually inaccurate or untruthful content relative to the model's training data or input. Hallucinations are also sometimes referred to lack of faithfulness or lack of groundedness. In some instances, synthetic data that is generated by large language models might include hallucinations that result in the data possibly being inaccurate, fabricated, or disconnected from reality. Hallucinations can compromise model performance, accuracy, and relevance.
possible_risks.justification: instruction-tuned chat model with no RLHF and no reported factuality/hallucination evaluation, only AlpacaEval 2.0 style preference score, so hallucination risk is plausibly raised

possible_risks.description: AI, and large generative models in particular, might produce increased carbon emissions and increase water usage for their training and operation.
possible_risks.justification: 70B dense decoder-only model fine-tuned on 3M-scale datasets; training and serving such a large open-weight model plausibly increases carbon/water usage

possible_risks.description: A metric selected to measure or track a risk is incorrectly selected, incompletely measuring the risk, or measuring the wrong risk for the given context.
possible_risks.justification: card reports only AlpacaEval 2.0 win-rate as favorable evidence, which measures style/instruction following rather than safety, factuality, or privacy risks

specifications.model_size: 131.4 GiB of safetensors weights (141,107,497,872 bytes) in BF16

training_context.adaptations: The model is a fine-tune of Infinity-Instruct-3M-Llama3-70B, trained on Infinity-Instruct-3M and Infinity-Instruct-0613 to produce a stronger chat model.
training_context.training_data: This checkpoint is a fine-tune of the Infinity-Instruct-3M-Llama3-70B model, further trained on the Infinity-Instruct-3M and Infinity-Instruct-0613 datasets.
